Require exact-origin redirect allowlists plus DNS rebinding checks before sitemap network access
Parse XML with strict NONET streaming Reader and explicit byte/depth/document/entry bounds
Preserve original and normalized URL plus lastmod provenance while only frontiering in-scope page entries
Count accepted responses and request attempts on the scan for Prompt 072 reservation finalization
Treat equivalent Rails uniqueness-validation and database-constraint races as idempotent customer-mapping replays.
risks: Raw sitemap bodies are represented by digests until artifact transport is implemented; usage charging remains reservation-backed per-scan observation for Prompt 072 finalization.
